body.query: Please list the disparate time of the transactions taken place in the gas stations from chain no. 11.

raw_response.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.time
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.gas_station_id = g.gas_station_id
WHERE g.chain_id = 11
ORDER BY t.time;
